evals.prompt: My Express API is returning 500 errors randomly in production but I can't reproduce it locally. How should I approach this?
evals.expected_output: A structured debugging approach that starts with log analysis before jumping to fixes, focuses on reproducing the issue reliably, and distinguishes between root cause vs symptoms

evals.prompt: I need to add a notifications feature to my Django app. Users should get notified when someone comments on their post. Where do I start?
evals.expected_output: A planning-first response that explores the codebase/stack first, defines the architecture (model, signal/async task, delivery channel), and lays out an ordered implementation plan before writing any code

evals.prompt: I have a React component that's 400 lines long, handles API calls, manages form state, and renders the UI. My team is complaining it's impossible to test. How do I fix this?
evals.expected_output: Advice that follows React conventions — separating concerns into custom hooks (data fetching, form state), smaller presentational components, and keeping the parent as a thin coordinator — with a step-by-step refactor plan
